mapper.select: select c1.table_Name as table_Code,c1.column_Name as column_Code,c2.Column_Name,c1.data_Type,c1.data_Length,c1.data_Precision,c1.data_Scale,c2.Column_Remark from sys.user_tab_columns c1 left join Sys_TableColumn c2 on c1.Column_Name=c2.Column_Code and Table_Code=c1.Table_Name where lower(table_Code)=lower(#{tableName}) order by c1.column_Id asc;

select t1.table_name as tableCode,t1.column_name as columnCode,c2.Column_Name,Column_Remark,t1.data_type as dataType,IFNULL(t1.character_maximum_length,t1.numeric_precision) as dataLength,t1.ORDINAL_POSITION as columnId, t1.column_type as columnType,t1.numeric_precision as dataPrecision,t1.numeric_scale as dataScale FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.Columns t1 left join Sys_TableColumn c2 on t1.column_name=c2.Column_Code and c2.Table_Code=t1.table_name where lower(table_Code)=lower(#{tableName}) order by t1.ORDINAL_POSITION asc;

select t1.table_name as tableCode,t1.column_name as columnCode,c2.Column_Name,Column_Remark,t1.data_type as dataType,IFNULL(t1.character_maximum_length,t1.numeric_precision) as dataLength,t1.ORDINAL_POSITION as columnId, t1.column_type as columnType,t1.numeric_precision as dataPrecision,t1.numeric_scale as dataScale FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.Columns t1 left join Sys_TableColumn c2 on t1.column_name=c2.Column_Code and c2.Table_Code=t1.table_name where lower(table_Code)=lower(#{tableName}) order by t1.ORDINAL_POSITION asc;
